purpose: Teach: ハワイアン/ノーマル/ヤンキー/ハーモニー/ユニオン/ベール/ダイジェスト/レベルアップ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハワイアンのウクレレ習い始めたな
lines.en: Riku — you actually started learning ukulele? The Hawaiian kind?
lines.style: Light, teasing accusation with genuine curiosity underneath. Leans in slightly. Watching his face for the reaction. Quick rhythm, almost playful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノーマルなジャージで来てたな、桜
lines.en: You showed up in regular gym clothes, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection. Side-eye glance. Not quite defensive, more like he's turning the mirror back on her. Flat delivery, barely a smile playing at the corner.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヤンキー漫画読みすぎだろ
lines.en: Riku, you're reading too much manga about delinquents or something.
lines.style: Mock-exasperated, but affectionate underneath. Quick rhythm, light jab. She's not actually annoyed — she's matching his energy. Slight grin in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、合唱コンクールでハーモニー上手かったな、桜
lines.en: You were actually really good at harmony in the choir competition, Sakura.
lines.style: Sincere compliment delivered quietly, almost reluctantly. Steady eye contact implied. Not overdone — he means it, and he's slightly mortified to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、社会でユニオンジャックの旗習ったろ
lines.en: Riku — remember when we learned about the Union Jack flag in history class?
lines.style: Conversational pivot, curious and testing. Lighter tone now. She's drawing him into a new thread, watching to see if he'll follow.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で寺院のベールに包まれた像見たろ、桜
lines.en: You saw those veiled statues at the temple on the school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation. Wondering tone — like he's following her thread and adding his own. Slow pace. Genuine question, not a test.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカーの試合のダイジェスト観てたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you watching the soccer match highlights earlier.
lines.style: Casual observation, no judgment. Almost conversational. She's noticed something small about him and letting him know in the gentlest way.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームのキャラのレベルアップ語ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were going on about leveling up your game character the other day, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry, knowing. Low energy, slight smirk in the delivery. He's caught her at something small and he's not making a big deal of it. Intimate tone — close friends noticing close friends.
